name: Motor and driver ICs
summary: Chips that switch motors, relays and steppers on behalf of a microcontroller.
uses: Driving a DC motor both ways (H-bridge)
Running stepper motors from scrapped printers
Switching relays and solenoids from logic
identify: Chips or small boards near the motors in printers, scanners, toys, optical drives, robots and 3D printers, marked L298, L293, ULN2003, DRV8825, A4988 or TB6612.
test: Hard to test alone; try it in a known circuit. One that runs hot with no load or has a burnt top is dead.
